500._measured: 2026-10-29 on darwin/arm64, Apple M3 Max (14 cores), n=500 schemas in one generated gen package, s=100 services, GOFLAGS=-p=2. The build cost is checked as CPU time (user + system of each command and the children it reaped) over a reference build in the same run: the module ref (its own go.mod; a main that imports net/http), built cold with a fresh GOCACHE before the cold build and after the schema edit; the ratio's denominator is the mean of the two. Three runs, one at a time, at 1-minute load averages of 14.46, 9.84 and 9.82 before each. Reference CPU (before, after) 29.88, 28.76 / 30.80, 29.33 / 28.78, 27.53 s. Cold build CPU 186.59, 188.97, 182.63 s, cold_build_x 6.36, 6.29, 6.49 (spread 3%); schema edit + regenerate + rebuild CPU 155.83, 151.16, 148.91 s, schema_edit_rebuild_x 5.32, 5.03, 5.29 (spread 6%). Rule: each _x threshold is 2x the largest of three runs, rounded up to 0.1 (12.98 -> 13.0, 10.64 -> 10.7); a variant whose three ratios spread by more than 25% would be report-only (its _x keys omitted), which this one is not. Wall-clock times (cold_build_s, schema_edit_rebuild_s: 47.5, 47.5, 47.9 s and 42.6, 42.3, 41.2 s) are printed for information only and not checked. Sizes and memory are unchanged from the 2026-10-19 calibration (1.5x the largest of three runs then: service 5.66 MB, link peak 279.3 MB); these runs measured 5.83 MB and 262.7 to 262.9 MB. At 11.33 MB (2x) a leak of a few hundred entities back into a service would pass, and at 558 MB the link peak of the earlier connected-graph build (404 MB, 23.6 MB binary) would pass; these thresholds fail it. Recalibrate from the first Linux CI run (followups, 1.0 release)

500-graphql._measured: 2026-10-29 on darwin/arm64, Apple M3 Max (14 cores), the -graphql variant: n=500 schemas that also carry velox-graphql's annotations (a root query field, OrderField and WhereOps on name), generated with -plugin velox-graphql into one gen package, s=100 services that each call the root connection function and the next edge's method of five entities, GOFLAGS=-p=2. Checked as CPU-time ratios to the reference build, as in the 500 entry. Three runs, one at a time, at 1-minute load averages of 10.44, 8.55 and 10.57 before each. Reference CPU (before, after) 29.17, 30.30 / 29.69, 27.26 / 30.18, 27.32 s. Cold build CPU 420.85, 411.81, 423.11 s, cold_build_x 14.15, 14.46, 14.72 (spread 4%); schema edit CPU 423.53, 360.70, 374.39 s, schema_edit_rebuild_x 14.24, 12.67, 13.02 (spread 12%). Rule of the 500 entry: 2x the largest, rounded up to 0.1 (29.44 -> 29.5, 28.48 -> 28.5); the spreads are under 25%, so the variant gates. Wall-clock times (125.3, 122.3, 124.8 s cold; 131.2, 109.9, 115.7 s edit) are printed for information only and not checked. Sizes and memory are unchanged from the 2026-10-22 calibration (1.5x of 11.11 MB and 662.2 MB); these runs measured 11.49 MB and 654.1 to 654.3 MB. The service is twice the plain variant's because it links the GraphQL runtime, which does not grow with n. Recalibrate from the first Linux CI run (followups, 1.0 release)
